title: ENOT: Expectile Regularization for Fast and Accurate Training of Neural Optimal Transport
tldr_zh: 用 expectile 回归正则隐式逼近 c-conjugate（τ→1 收敛到 sup），免内层优化；W2 benchmark 误差最多降 3 倍、时间最多快 10 倍
tldr_en: Expectile regression on dual potentials implicitly approximates the c-conjugate without inner optimization; up to 3x lower error and 10x faster on the Wasserstein-2 benchmark.
key_numbers: CelebA64 W2 benchmark Early/Mid/Late: 0.32/0.08/0.04 vs W2OT L-BFGS 0.62/0.20/0.09 (Table 1)
Runtime (min) HD D=2..256: ENOT 14-21 vs W2OT 91-1028 (Table 9); 2D 20k steps ~1.3 min vs 60-300 min (Table 8)
Unpaired I2I FID: Handbags->Shoes 19.19, FFHQ->Comics 17.11, CelebA->Anime64 13.12, Anime128 18.85 vs Extremal OT 27.10/20.95/14.65/19.44 (Table 3)
